text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your efforts earlier.
I have duly received the list of honored guests.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems many prominent figures will be coming to spectate the next race as well.
...To judge whether I possess the 'caliber of a king'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Do not worry so. Standing in the public eye is an experience I have had countless times before.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Whatever the arena may be,
there is but one duty I must fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With the pride dwelling within my chest, I have only one course:
to steadfastly fulfill my duty as the one who leads our house.
